results.title: Analog in-memory computing attention mechanism for fast ...
results.content: Analog in-memory computing attention mechanism for fast and energy-efficient large language models. # Analog in-memory computing attention mechanism for fast and energy-efficient large language models. Here we present a custom self-attention in-memory computing architecture based on emerging charge-based memories called gain cells, which can be efficiently written to store new tokens during sequence generation and enable parallel analog dot-product computation required for self-attention. In this work, we propose an IMC hardware architecture based on emerging charge-based memory devices, known as gain cells26."),27."), to store token projections and compute dot products for the attention mechanism. * An in-memory, mixed analog–digital computing design to store token projections and compute attention dot products with gain-cell arrays at high energy efficiency. As the nonlinear relation between input voltage and stored voltage in gain cells is described by a third-order polynomial function, this substantially increases the computational complexity and memory requirements to train our gain-cell-based model.
